scope: Oito adultos novos, anatomia primeiro e proteção localizada, nomes e lore propostos; não substituem as famílias ou os draconianos anteriores.

members.name: Gravurso
members.title: Lorde do Último Apoio
members.lore: Sustenta passagens que estão cedendo até que o último companheiro atravesse. Só vence quando consegue soltar o peso sem esmagar aquilo que protege.
members.spec: A massive BEAR-like living-kite LORD, BIPED but very nonhuman: short thick neck, deep barrel torso, huge low shoulders, TWO long pendulous arms with enormous wide shovel-like claw hands, TWO short bowed legs and broad THREE-toed bear feet. Head squat SMALL relative to enormous forearms, short square DARK SLATE/ivory muzzle, heavy cheek paper tufts, tiny icy BLUE eyes and two short rounded folded earcorners, no helmet/horns. BODY dominant warm IVORY paper, broad slate throat and underside shadow, ARMOR only dull BRONZE block manacles at BOTH wrists and a broad open structural neck/shoulder YOKE, visible chest/upperarms/thighs; no chest cuirass. Two wide dark UMBER paper sails hang behind shoulders like folded lifting straps, not cape wings. Signature: forearm braces have TWO broad open load-bearing bamboo hooks each, attached at a single real knot hinge, allow palms to brace/fold a surface; all 2 arms visible and empty claws open as though catching falling weight. Grounded forward crouch, shoulders above hands not a bodybuilder human. ONE thick umber braided soul-rabiola rooted rump, terminal a single bronze/ivory folded square load tag. Quiet abdomen with ONE broad central tension fold, NOT muscular abs, no runes. More power in silhouette and hands than equipment.

members.name: Avelince
members.title: Lorde da Contracorrente
members.lore: Atravessa investidas com um desvio mínimo e devolve a força para o chão. Suas velas só funcionam quando o corpo aceita girar junto.
members.spec: LARGE QUADRUPED LYNX-like beast LORD, FOUR long sprung legs with FOUR wide taloned feline feet, high shoulder hips low stalking turn, deep chest and long flexible spine. Small exposed mature feline paper HEAD with SHORT wide snout, heavy angular muzzle not dragonbeak, small VIOLET eyes, TWO long triangular ear TUFT-SAILS built on curved bamboo ribs not horns. BODY dominant warm LIGHT GRAY taut paper with only a few dark-gray cheek/ankle tufts. ARMOR dark PLUM limited to near shoulder guard and TWO front shin rings, no full torso armor or rear greaves. Signature TWO large sweeping offwhite/plum kite membranes anchored from shoulder rib to flanks as ONE paired flexible steering mantle, one furling upward and one opening downward during lateral pivot; not bat wings or flat decorative cape. Rooted ribs meet shoulder joints clearly; face, FOUR feet and belly exposed. Tail anatomical short bobtail incorporated into ONE slim plum braided soul-rabiola ending forked pale gray flag. Small violet eye/hinge accent only, no gold borders/runes/halo. Dynamic low turning stance with near forepaw braced and opposite rear leg extended, count four roots.

members.name: Torvargo
members.title: Lorde do Primeiro Impacto
members.lore: Abre um caminho pela barreira, mas precisa reconhecer o que há atrás dela antes de avançar. A marca de um golpe certo é a passagem que permanece de pé.
members.spec: BIPED boar-RHINO hybrid BEAST lord with huge deep forward-leaning torso and humped shoulder ridge, small low short square BOAR skull with flat angular DARK nose, small MINT eyes, TWO short thick ivory folded tusks curving SIDEWAYS not up into eyes, thick slate cheek paper tufts. TWO powerful LOW arms ending THREE large clawed digits plus thumb and TWO compact weighty legs with split hooved-claw feet. BODY dominant CHARCOAL taut paper, broad quiet ivory belly/throat tension membrane. ARMOR color dull CORAL RED, localized on ONE huge asymmetric near shoulder IMPACT SHELL and BOTH squat forearm bracers; chest/upperarms/thighs visible and not muscular human abs. Signature shoulder shell has broad closed crescent battering face with one inset bamboo load arch, no snarling heads or spikes; near arm angles forward protecting head, far arm counterbalances fully visible. TWO narrow dark-red rear paper pennant plates stabilize rump, no broad cape. ONE charcoal braided rabiola rooted rear pelvis with single coral blunt-chevron flag. Feet wide in ready-to-charge pose, not cartoon pig, no helmet or giant hammer. Coral only armor fields, no colored trims.

members.name: Najarcal
members.title: Lorde do Círculo Aberto
members.lore: Prende a ameaça num círculo que sempre conserva uma saída. Se fechar a última abertura, aprisiona também quem veio salvar.
members.spec: SERPENT LORD with TWO long articulated NONHUMAN arms and NO legs, ONE very thick grounded S-coil tail supporting high powerful upper trunk, no human waist or abs. Small mature COBRA paper head, broad LOW upper skull, long shallow flattened snout, THREE short ivory teeth, small deep BLUE eyes under paper brow, no human smile, crown or animal helmet. BODY dominant pale SAND/ivory taut paper with only ONE broad dark gray throatfold; hood has THREE huge paper panels on curved bamboo spars, broad and calm, not manytiny scales. ARMOR one deep TEAL color confined to paired upperarm load cuffs and TWO large external tail-anchor plates, big exposed torso and coil. Signature arms each carry ONE open C-shaped rigid TEAL restraint hoop attached at wrist by a knot hinge; not weapons held floating, open palms still visible, hoop geometry leaves an obvious opening. Twoarms spread at different levels to shape a containment circle, body upright yet serpentine and alive. ONE thin dark teal braided soul-rabiola at tip of anatomical tail with ivory single crescent flag, no extra cord. No cape/halo/crystals/runes, matte flat large masses and clear negative space in hoops.

members.name: Raptório
members.title: Lorde do Instante Partido
members.lore: Interrompe um golpe antes que ele alcance outro parceiro. Precisa recolher as próprias garras a tempo para não transformar defesa em perseguição.
members.spec: BIPED RAPTOR bird BEAST LORD, TWO enormous long WING-FOREARMS with articulated hooked claw hands at wrist and broad folded feather-paper vanes behind arm; these are ONE pair of arms, NOT extra back wings. TWO long reverse-jointed powerful bird legs with huge THREE TALON feet, deeply keeled exposed chest with broad offwhite taut paper planes and a few directional neck ruff folds. Head SMALL sharp adult hawk skull with compact curved graphite beak, small MINT eyes, TWO swept broad triangular crest folds ivory, no helmet, human lips or owl-round face. BODY dominant OFFWHITE/stone gray paper, ARMOR dark NAVY localized to wrist knuckle guards and one broad segmented knee brace on each leg; chest and upperarms visible, no full suit. Signature wrist gauntlets carry TWO blunt outward curved catching prongs like parallel kite ribs, coherent with claws, medium feather vanes angle backward when hands spread to intercept. Slight threequarter swoop landing with one foot bracing and other lifted but both roots clear, no spear/sword. ONE navy braided soul-rabiola rooted at anatomical tail tip, three ivory feather-pennants. Navy armor plain no gold edging, few calm planar shapes not fluttering paper shards.

members.name: Cervoráculo
members.title: Lorde da Rota Restante
members.lore: Encontra a rota que ainda pode sustentar a travessia. Cada direção que aponta exige que ele abandone outra, em vez de prometer todos os caminhos.
members.spec: QUADRUPED STAG BEAST LORD, FOUR long sturdy legs FOUR split hooves, short strong back and deep proud chest, NO human arms. Exposed small ELONGATED deer head with broad blunt nonhuman muzzle and big triangular paper ears, SMALL mature crimson eyes under angular brow, not giant doe eyes. BODY dominant IVORY/very pale gray taut paper with broad quiet throat and belly; ARMOR one dark FOREST GREEN limited to shoulder saddle and TWO foreleg broad knee cuffs, visible chest/neck and hindlegs. Signature ANTLERS are TWO LARGE CURVED BAMBOO ARCS carrying only THREE broad ivory paper triangular sails each, asymmetrically tilted like directional windrudders, not a huge forest of branches or a decorative halo. They grow from two temple knots and point forward/back with clear load path into strong neck; green saddle has a wide open back collar to anchor their tension, no glittering gems. Anatomical tail short with ONE forest green braided soul-rabiola and forked ivory flag. Alert threequarter turn looking back over shoulder, FOUR legs clear, no weapon or wings; broad masses, no realistic fur/woodgrain. Small crimson accent only eyes/one knot.

members.name: Cascoronte
members.title: Lorde do Abrigo Móvel
members.lore: Oferece o próprio abrigo sem decidir quem merece entrar. Sua maior dificuldade é continuar avançando enquanto carrega o medo dos outros.
members.spec: Massive QUADRUPED TORTOISE-RHINO paper BEAST LORD, FOUR short huge pillar legs and FOUR broad THREE claw feet, deep LOW body, thick short neck, SMALL exposed square turtle/dragon skull with blunt hooked upper jaw not bird beak and small BLUE eyes, TWO ivory fold cheek fins and heavy lower jaw, no helmet. BODY dominant pale warm GRAY/ivory taut paper, no wrinkles/real scales or muscle strands; limbs bulky with 2 big compressionfolds only. ARMOR SINGLE dark OXBLOOD color: ONE immense layered shelter SHELL arch with THREE broad overlapping plates and TWO foreankle cuffs, no gold trim or ornamental masks. Signature shell's near side lifts as ONE broad hinged PAPER AWNING on TWO internal bamboo ribs, clearly rooted in shell not separatewing; open negative-space beneath awning communicates shelter while underlying belly/legs remain visible. Ridge of shell offset with flat big calm panels, not every panel a diamond. ONE thick charcoal braided soul-rabiola at rear ends a single oxblood roof-chevron flag. Threequarter walking stance slow resilient adult weight, no weapons/cape/crystals/runes. Fourlegged continuous anatomy, not a turtle shell on human.

members.name: Mantigardo
members.title: Lorde da Linha Íntegra
members.lore: Separa linhas enroscadas sem cortar a que mantém um parceiro vivo. Para ele, precisão significa deixar que o outro volte a se mover sozinho.
members.spec: INSECTOID MANTIS BEAST LORD with SIX LIMBS TOTAL: TWO enormous folded raptorial FOREARMS ending living PAPER scythe-claws, FOUR slender but strong walking legs with FOUR hooked feet clearly visible (two pairs), NO human hands or extra wings. Tall triangular SMALL mantis head with TWO small dark violet eyes and broad angular cheek planes, closed THREE-piece jaw palps, two short bamboo antennae, NOT cute giant bug eyes or human visor. BODY dominant DARK PLUM taut-paper membranes with a pale ivory long segmented throat and TWO broad calm thorax planes (no human abs); ARMOR one muted BRASS localized to TWO forearm OUTER hinge sleeves and ONE high back saddle, exposed living claw inner edges and fourlegs. Signature forearm claws have long blunt ivory folded cutting-guides separated by a CLEAR OPEN GAP so they can lift threads apart; not two swords held by human fists. TWO compact broad ivory/plum folded ELytra sails rooted at upper back, only one plate each no huge butterflywings, incomplete shine. ONE thin plum braided soul-rabiola at abdomen tip with two pale ivory pennants, antennae not cords. Controlled poised guardian ready to disentangle, six limb roots coherent, not generic humanoid knight.
